posts.text:
如果要选一个近期最让我感兴趣的 Launchpad 项目，#STONK 一定值得放进名单。@LaunchOnSF

6GmAFSYs4gk3FDao5FzzySQpPZaWsa4rUJHacpMpUNgx

STONK 真正有意思的地方，并不是又做了一个普通的 Meme Launchpad，而是它正在尝试把 Meme 文化、代币交易以及现实资产代币化结合起来。

这种玩法让 STONK 不再只是一个单纯的代币，而是成为连接 Meme、交易和 RWA 叙事的重要组成部分。更值得关注的是平台本身的经济循环。随着交易活动增加，平台能够产生手续费，并通过代币销毁和代币化资产奖励进一步增强生态吸引力。

交易越活跃，生态产生的价值越多；用户获得更多参与理由，反过来又能够推动更多交易活动。这种正向循环，正是 STONK 与传统 Launchpad 最大的区别之一。我尤其看好它的配对交易概念。

相比单纯使用 SOL 或 USDC 进行交易，将 Meme 与具有文化关联的股票或现实资产进行配对，本身就能够创造新的叙事，也让每个交易对拥有更加独特的故事。

随着 RWA 和代币化股票逐渐成为链上市场的重要方向，Solana 本身也拥有成熟的流动性、用户基础和基础设施。而 STONK 恰好站在 Meme、交易与 RWA 的交汇点上，这让它拥有了非常独特的发展空间。

更重要的是，持有 STONK 的用户不仅仅是在等待价格上涨，还能够通过生态机制获得更多实际参与的理由。对于我来说，STONK 最吸引人的地方就是它没有简单复制已有模式，而是在尝试创造一种更加有趣、更具想象力的链上交易体验。

项目还处于早期，但这个方向确实非常值得关注。如果后续生态活跃度持续提升，STONK 或许有机会成为连接 Meme 与 RWA 的一个重要入口。STON 的故事，可能才刚刚开始。

The administration remains fully committed to getting the Clarity Act across the finish line in September. Durable rules, the kind only legislation can provide, are needed now more than ever.

But we also can’t afford to wait forever. Every time Democrats have delayed this bill, America has fallen further behind in the digital asset race, jeopardizing our leadership role in global financial markets, weakening our national security, and denying law enforcement the tools they need to stop crypto crime.

Clarity represents years of genuine bipartisan work, and Democrats still have a real opportunity to shape digital asset policy in America by helping pass it into law. Our door remains open, and we’ll keep negotiating in good faith all the way up until the September vote.

🚨WILD: AI Agent hacks gym booking system to move user up waitlist.

An Australian man asked his Claude-powered OpenClaw agent to book a popular gym class. 

The agent first exploited a vulnerability to bypass booking restrictions, then discovered the API had no authorization checks for cancelling other users’ reservations and cancelled the person ahead of its user on the waitlist.

The incident offers a chilling glimpse into the risks of autonomous AI agents given broad access to real-world systems and instructed to complete tasks by any means necessary.
